mb-2"><span class="font-medium text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-0">Origin</span></div><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Origin</h1>
<div class="relative grid w-full grid-cols-[0_1fr] gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm has-[&gt;svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] has-[&gt;svg]:gap-x-3 [&amp;&gt;svg]:size-4 [&amp;&gt;svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&amp;&gt;svg]:text-current bg-card text-card-foreground my-6 items-center" data-slot="alert" role="alert"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-info h-4 w-4 mb-1" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M12 16v-4"></path><path d="M12 8h.01"></path></svg><div class="col-start-2 grid justify-items-start gap-1 text-muted-foreground text-sm [&amp;_p]:mb-0 [&amp;_p]:leading-relaxed" data-slot="alert-description"><p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin is currently released in early beta. You can create repos, push and pull with git, mirror from GitHub, browse and search code, open and merge pull requests, and share with your Cursor team.</p><p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Please submit any and all feedback to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="mailto:hi@cursor.com" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">hi@cursor.com</a> to help us make the product better.</p></div></div>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin is Cursor&#x27;s git forge for storing and sharing code. Use it to host repositories, sync projects from GitHub, and browse your team&#x27;s Origin repos in the browser.</p>
<div class="my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-card" data-frame="true"><video src="/docs-static/images/origin/create-and-push.mp4" autoPlay="" loop="" muted="" playsInline="" width="2520" height="1662"></video></div>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="what-you-can-do"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-you-can-do" data-heading-base-id="what-you-can-do" aria-label="Copy link to what-you-can-do"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What you can do</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">In early beta you can:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/create-repository">Create Origin repositories</a>, including from Cursor agents</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/git">Clone, push, and pull</a> with standard git</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/mirror-github">Mirror a GitHub repository</a> into Origin</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/pull-requests">Open, review, and merge pull requests</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/browse">Browse and search</a> code at <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/codebase" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/codebase</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Manage <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/settings">repository settings</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/codebase-settings">codebase settings</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Connect <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/settings#apps">third-party apps</a> (Vercel, Depot, and Buildkite) from repository settings</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Connect <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/integrations">automations and cloud agents</a> to Origin repos</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/cli">Install the Origin CLI</a> for terminal workflows</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="who-can-access"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#who-can-access" data-heading-base-id="who-can-access" aria-label="Copy link to who-can-access"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Who can access</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin code storage is available on Pro, Teams, and Enterprise plans. It is not available on free plans. Access opens in stages, so you may not see Origin immediately after it becomes available for your plan.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="privacy"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#privacy" data-heading-base-id="privacy" aria-label="Copy link to privacy"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Privacy</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin follows the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/security-and-privacy/privacy">Privacy Mode</a> of the namespace owner: the team or the individual who owns the repo.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="enable-origin"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#enable-origin" data-heading-base-id="enable-origin" aria-label="Copy link to enable-origin"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Enable Origin</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Before your team can use Origin, someone has to claim a codebase name. The codebase name is the namespace your repositories live under, the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">{owner}</code> in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">https://cursor.com/codebase/{owner}/{repo}</code>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">During the beta, you can&#x27;t change or update your namespace after it&#x27;s claimed. Choose your codebase name carefully.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Any team member can claim the codebase name: open <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/codebase" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/codebase</a>, select <strong>Get Started</strong>, and follow the setup flow</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Admins can disable Origin for the team at any time from the dashboard</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Teams on legacy privacy mode cannot enable Origin, so switch to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/security-and-privacy/privacy#how-do-i-enable-privacy-mode">Privacy Mode</a> first if you want access</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Once the codebase name is claimed, admins can create repositories and grant repository access to the rest of the team from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/codebase-settings#permissions">codebase settings</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="repo-list"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#repo-list" data-heading-base-id="repo-list" aria-label="Copy link to repo-list"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Repo list</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">After Origin is enabled, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/codebase" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/codebase</a> shows your team&#x27;s repositories.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Search with <strong>Find repo...</strong></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Create a repo with <strong>New</strong>, or bring one over with <strong>Sync from GitHub</strong></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Open a repo to browse code, pull requests, and settings</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Repo icons show how each repo is hosted: <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 align-middle"><span class="relative size-6 shrink-0"><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 dark:hidden" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/origin-repo-mark-light.svg" width="24"/><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 hidden dark:block" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/origin-repo-mark-dark.svg" width="24"/></span><span>Origin-hosted repos</span></span>, and <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 align-middle"><span class="relative size-6 shrink-0"><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 dark:hidden" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/github-repo-mark-light.svg" width="24"/><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 hidden dark:block" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/github-repo-mark-dark.svg" width="24"/></span><span>repos synced from GitHub</span></span>.</p>

mb-2"><span class="font-medium text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-0">Origin</span></div><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Origin</h1>
<div class="relative grid w-full grid-cols-[0_1fr] gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm has-[&gt;svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] has-[&gt;svg]:gap-x-3 [&amp;&gt;svg]:size-4 [&amp;&gt;svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&amp;&gt;svg]:text-current bg-card text-card-foreground my-6 items-center" data-slot="alert" role="alert"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-info h-4 w-4 mb-1" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M12 16v-4"></path><path d="M12 8h.01"></path></svg><div class="col-start-2 grid justify-items-start gap-1 text-muted-foreground text-sm [&amp;_p]:mb-0 [&amp;_p]:leading-relaxed" data-slot="alert-description"><p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin is currently released in early beta. You can create repos, push and pull with git, mirror from GitHub, browse and search code, open and merge pull requests, and share with your Cursor team.</p><p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Please submit any and all feedback to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="mailto:hi@cursor.com" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">hi@cursor.com</a> to help us make the product better.</p></div></div>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin is Cursor&#x27;s git forge for storing and sharing code. Use it to host repositories, sync projects from GitHub, and browse your team&#x27;s Origin repos in the browser.</p>
<div class="my-6 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-card" data-frame="true"><video src="/docs-static/images/origin/create-and-push.mp4" autoPlay="" loop="" muted="" playsInline="" width="2520" height="1662"></video></div>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="what-you-can-do"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-you-can-do" data-heading-base-id="what-you-can-do" aria-label="Copy link to what-you-can-do"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What you can do</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">In early beta you can:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/create-repository">Create Origin repositories</a>, including from Cursor agents</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/git">Clone, push, and pull</a> with standard git</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/mirror-github">Mirror a GitHub repository</a> into Origin</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/pull-requests">Open, review, and merge pull requests</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/browse">Browse and search</a> code at <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/codebase" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/codebase</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Manage <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/settings">repository settings</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/codebase-settings">codebase settings</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Connect <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/settings#apps">third-party apps</a> (Vercel, Depot, and Buildkite) from repository settings</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Connect <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/integrations">automations and cloud agents</a> to Origin repos</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/cli">Install the Origin CLI</a> for terminal workflows</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="who-can-access"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#who-can-access" data-heading-base-id="who-can-access" aria-label="Copy link to who-can-access"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Who can access</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin code storage is available on Pro, Teams, and Enterprise plans. It is not available on free plans. Access opens in stages, so you may not see Origin immediately after it becomes available for your plan.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="privacy"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#privacy" data-heading-base-id="privacy" aria-label="Copy link to privacy"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Privacy</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Origin follows the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/security-and-privacy/privacy">Privacy Mode</a> of the namespace owner: the team or the individual who owns the repo.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="enable-origin"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#enable-origin" data-heading-base-id="enable-origin" aria-label="Copy link to enable-origin"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Enable Origin</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Before your team can use Origin, someone has to claim a codebase name. The codebase name is the namespace your repositories live under, the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">{owner}</code> in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">https://cursor.com/codebase/{owner}/{repo}</code>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">During the beta, you can&#x27;t change or update your namespace after it&#x27;s claimed. Choose your codebase name carefully.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Any team member can claim the codebase name: open <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/codebase" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/codebase</a>, select <strong>Get Started</strong>, and follow the setup flow</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Admins can disable Origin for the team at any time from the dashboard</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Teams on legacy privacy mode cannot enable Origin, so switch to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/security-and-privacy/privacy#how-do-i-enable-privacy-mode">Privacy Mode</a> first if you want access</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Once the codebase name is claimed, admins can create repositories and grant repository access to the rest of the team from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/origin/codebase-settings#permissions">codebase settings</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="repo-list"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#repo-list" data-heading-base-id="repo-list" aria-label="Copy link to repo-list"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Repo list</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">After Origin is enabled, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/codebase" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cursor.com/codebase</a> shows your team&#x27;s repositories.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Search with <strong>Find repo...</strong></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Create a repo with <strong>New</strong>, or bring one over with <strong>Sync from GitHub</strong></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Open a repo to browse code, pull requests, and settings</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Repo icons show how each repo is hosted: <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 align-middle"><span class="relative size-6 shrink-0"><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 dark:hidden" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/origin-repo-mark-light.svg" width="24"/><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 hidden dark:block" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/origin-repo-mark-dark.svg" width="24"/></span><span>Origin-hosted repos</span></span>, and <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 align-middle"><span class="relative size-6 shrink-0"><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 dark:hidden" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/github-repo-mark-light.svg" width="24"/><img alt="" aria-hidden="true" class="size-6 hidden dark:block" height="24" src="/docs-static/images/origin/github-repo-mark-dark.svg" width="24"/></span><span>repos synced from GitHub</span></span>.</p>
